reason: Contig depth counts all mapped reads, and none of these depth calculators filters on MAPQ by default. The KBase MetaBAT2 app runs its bundled jgi_summarize_bam_contig_depths without --minMapQual (help text: '(default: 0)'; it does apply '--percentIdentity ... (default: 97)'). CONCOCT runs 'samtools bedcov' without -Q (samtools 1.3.1 bedcov.c: 'min_mapQ = 0'). MaxBin's _getabund.pl counts any read whose reference field is not '*', subject to a mismatch cap. So the MAPQ and seed-policy fixes barely move depth profiles. The multithreaded SAM-corruption bug would more likely crash a run than shift coverage quietly. Re-mapping with current Bowtie2 is sensible if coverage is recomputed for re-binning, but the version gap alone does not justify leaving KBase.

reason: The code gap (effectively 1.4.0 against 1.5.0) is negligible for MAG annotation, and DRAM2 is beta. The real gap is the 2022-09-27 database snapshot with no UniRef90. Otherwise the KBase run in progress (queue_dram_jobs.py) keeps MAGs and references on the same annotator.
